forbidden: public Java/.NET/C/C++/JavaScript numeric interop defining guest semantics
implicit binary64 coercion for BigInt or Decimal
host overflow/wrap behavior leaking through Math.abs or Math.neg

types.f32: IEEE-754 binary32; must be a distinct representation or rejected
types.BigInt: arbitrary-precision signed integer subject to explicit resource budgets
types.Decimal: arbitrary-precision/resource-bounded base-10 coefficient plus signed scale
types.DecimalContext: immutable explicit precision and rounding policy

Math.abs.int: same type; minimum signed value reports ArithmeticOverflowError
Math.abs.f64: clear sign bit; -0 -> +0; infinities preserved positive; NaN remains NaN

Math.neg.int: same type; minimum signed value reports ArithmeticOverflowError

bigint_api.quot: BigInt.quot(dividend: BigInt, divisor: BigInt) -> Result<BigInt, DivisionByZeroError>
bigint_api.rem: BigInt.rem(dividend: BigInt, divisor: BigInt) -> Result<BigInt, DivisionByZeroError>
bigint_api.div_rem: BigInt.div_rem(dividend: BigInt, divisor: BigInt) -> Result<(BigInt, BigInt), DivisionByZeroError>

decimal_api.divide_exact: Decimal.divide_exact(a: Decimal, b: Decimal) -> Result<Decimal, DecimalDivisionError>
decimal_api.divide: Decimal.divide(a: Decimal, b: Decimal, context: DecimalContext) -> Result<Decimal, DivisionByZeroError>
decimal_api.round: Decimal.round(value: Decimal, context: DecimalContext) -> Result<Decimal, NumericContextError>
